name: Gasthaus Obergaisberg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Obergaisberg in Kirchberg in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, **Gasthaus Obergaisberg** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality with breathtaking mountain views. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy inn offers warm, rustic charm and hearty **Tiroler** cuisine.

Indulge in traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Tiroler Gröstl**, all made with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the scenic trails of **Kirchberg in Tirol**, relax in our cozy lounge with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier**.

Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Gasthaus Obergaisberg** promises an unforgettable stay in the stunning **Tirol** countryside.
